item.title: MLB Pipeline drops their new Washington Nationals top 30 prospect list
item.description: This morning, MLB Pipeline released their updated top 30 prospect list for the Washington Nationals. item.title: What Washington Nationals fans learned from Josiah Gray’s return to action
item.description: Josiah Gray made his long awaited return to action after missing most of the last two seasons due to Tommy John Surgery. He was solid, but not spectacular in his return. Gray went 1.2 innings, but he would have completed two if not for a dropped third strike. His stuff was crisp, especially in the […]

item.title: What to expect from Foster Griffin in his first start with the Washington Nationals
item.description: The first free agent signing Paul Toboni made was a bit of a mysterious one. He gave LHP Foster Griffin a 1-year $5.5 million deal after three excellent years in Japan. item.description: Having seen a couple weeks of Spring Training, it is clear who the Washington Nationals best pitcher is.
